finding.title: Make HierarchySelectionPanel's inline breadcrumb separator direction-aware (reuse breadcrumbSeparatorIcon)
finding.rule: AX-3 (directional glyphs) / consistency with established IL-7 invariant

evidence.quote:
IconData breadcrumbSeparatorIcon(TextDirection direction) =>
    direction == TextDirection.rtl ? Icons.chevron_left : Icons.chevron_right;

finding.why: breadcrumb_navigation.dart documents an already-fixed bug (IL-7 / R2 finding 4): "previously the hardcoded root-chip chevron disagreed with the inner ones in RTL," fixed by extracting breadcrumbSeparatorIcon() so "every separator in one trail points the same way" — and il7_il9_breadcrumb_selection_test.dart pins that invariant for BreadcrumbNavigation. HierarchySelectionPanel renders "its OWN inline breadcrumb (separate from BreadcrumbNavigation)" (its own docstring) and never adopted that helper: its separator is a bare `const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, ...)`. In RTL/Hebrew-terms mode, a user drilling into a multi-level curriculum via this panel (used across track setup, lifetime marking, and scope selection) sees a breadcrumb separator pointing the wrong way, inconsistent with every other breadcrumb trail in the app. No test catches it: il7_il9 only pumps the standalone BreadcrumbNavigation, and this batch's own r2_panel_leaf_crumb_ellipsis_test.dart pumps HierarchySelectionPanel in both LTR and RTL (lines 159-163) but never asserts the separator icon.
finding.recommendation: Replace the hardcoded `Icons.chevron_right` breadcrumb-separator Icon in hierarchy_selection_panel.dart with `breadcrumbSeparatorIcon(Directionality.of(context))` (or `terms.isHebrew ? TextDirection.rtl : TextDirection.ltr`, since `terms` is already in scope in this build method), and add an IL-7-style icon-direction assertion to a HierarchySelectionPanel breadcrumb test.
acceptance_criteria: hierarchy_selection_panel.dart's breadcrumb-separator Icon calls breadcrumbSeparatorIcon(...) instead of a literal Icons.chevron_right.

A widget test pumping HierarchySelectionPanel in RTL asserts find.byIcon(Icons.chevron_left) and findsNothing for chevron_right (mirroring il7_il9_breadcrumb_selection_test.dart), and is RED against the current hardcoded icon.
